messages.headline: The tan your clients ask for. Now in your treatment room.

blocks.html: Hi {{GREETING_NAME}},
I’m reaching out because {{BUSINESS_NAME}} looks like the kind of {{BUSINESS_TYPE}} that puts the finished result first.

Sunless by Jimmy Coco brings a red-carpet spray-tan look directly to professional treatment rooms: a natural-looking bronze finish, a clean luxury experience and a named service you can present as a premium booking rather than a generic tan.

The best way to assess the formula is on a real client in your own booth. Eligible UK professional partners can request a complimentary 100 ml professional trial sample, shipped free, before making any commercial decision.
Or simply reply TRIAL and Matthew will explain the review step personally.

messages.title: The formula details clients notice after their tan
messages.preview: Under 35 ml per full-body session, a 6–8-hour development window and standard HVLP compatibility.
messages.eyebrow: The result beyond the treatment room
messages.headline: A premium service has to look worth booking again.

blocks.html: Hi {{GREETING_NAME}},
The real test of a professional tan is not under treatment-room lighting. It is how the client feels wearing it later in daylight, in photographs and when they decide whether to rebook.

Malibu Professional Spray is a universal bronze, 10% DHA formula with a stated 6–8-hour development window. For day-to-day application, the formula uses under 35 ml for a full-body tan and works with standard HVLP systems.

items: Efficient application: a repeatable full-body application using under 35 ml with standard HVLP equipment.
Simplified professional setup: one universal bronze formula to assess in your own treatment-room workflow.

blocks.html: It supports a natural-looking finish and a clearer consultation conversation: the right depth and finish for the client’s plans, not simply how dark.
Prefer to test it with your team first? Reply SAMPLE and Matthew will help personally.

messages.title: The salon maths behind a premium tan (£2.14 per treatment)
messages.preview: Clear solution-cost economics and a direct route to professional ordering when you are ready.
messages.headline: The salon maths behind a premium named service.

blocks.html: Hi {{GREETING_NAME}},
Premium brand positioning only works if the treatment economics make sense for your business.
The current UK Malibu Professional Spray 1-litre bottle is £60 and yields approximately 28 full-body tans. That gives an approximate solution cost of £2.14 per tan.
That is not a profit promise and it is not a suggested treatment price. It is a clear baseline before you factor in your team, disposables, card fees, premises and VAT.
You can assess the formula on a real client first, or—if you already know the brand—review the professional litre and trade-order route directly.
Ready to review the product order route? View the professional 1-litre order page. Or reply NUMBERS for a service calculation using your own local pricing.

messages.title: The second revenue moment after the treatment
messages.preview: A focused aftercare edit that helps clients maintain the result between appointments.
messages.headline: The easiest retail conversation happens after the tan.

blocks.html: Hi {{GREETING_NAME}},
The most natural retail moment in a tanning studio is after a client looks in the mirror and asks how to keep their glow looking good until their next visit.
Rather than an overwhelming retail stand, Jimmy Coco Pro offers a focused three-product aftercare edit:

items: Buff & Glow Mitt: an even-looking maintenance routine.
Self Tan Soufflé: a controlled between-appointment top-up.
A-List Glow Kit: a complete routine or giftable option.

blocks.html: The professional service comes first. The aftercare recommendation simply helps the client maintain a result they already value. Trade pricing and any retail contribution are confirmed for the individual order quantity and partnership route.
Reply RETAIL if you would like Matthew to talk through the relevant order and aftercare route for your setting.

messages.title: What to look for when you test Jimmy Coco Pro
messages.preview: Assess application, finished result and service fit on a real client before deciding.
messages.headline: A useful trial gives you something real to judge.

blocks.html: Hi {{GREETING_NAME}},
By this stage, the key question is whether the solution performs in your hands, through your equipment and on your clients.
When you assess a complimentary 100 ml professional trial sample on a real client, there are three practical checks:

items: Application: how smoothly the solution works through your standard HVLP setup at under 35 ml for a full-body tan.
Finished result: how the universal bronze develops over its stated 6–8-hour window and reads in daylight and photographs.
Service fit: whether the colour, finish and consultation work for the service you want to offer.

blocks.html: There is no complex application process and no obligation. If the formula is right for your menu, the ongoing trade minimum is one 1-litre bottle (£60).
Reply TRIAL and Matthew will review the request personally.

blocks.html: Hi {{GREETING_NAME}},

Individual next step: review the order route and any available service-support materials directly with Matthew before making a wider commitment.
